pageCache.pageTitle: About Us – St Anne's Nursery School
pageCache.text:
St Anne's Nursery School
About Us
Welcome to St Anne’s Nursery.
St Anne’s is a two-form Nursery, serving a diverse and vibrant community in North Kensington. In 2014 we federated with Avondale Park Primary, and in 2023 together joined the Fox Federation with Ashburnham, Avonmore and Fox Primaries.
Our belief is that children are entitled to the highest quality teaching, an ambitious and exciting curriculum, a stimulating learning environment and a safe and caring place in which learning is of the highest quality. We ensure appropriate challenge and support so that all our children achieve their best – emotionally and academically. Visitors are struck by our confident, expressive children who are engaged in their learning and proud of their achievements – as well as the friendly and hardworking atmosphere created by staff, pupils and parents.
We have no more than 26 children per class, and several adults in each room. We are lucky to have a great staff of teachers, Teaching Assistants and Nursery Officers. The Nursery environment is purpose-built, with excellent indoor space and a great playground. Nursery also make use of the rest of the school site: full computer suite, two sports halls, music room, art room and two playgrounds.
As your child’s first teacher, you will be aware of your child’s needs, strengths and weaknesses and we hope to build upon that experience through a strong home–school partnership. We are happy to discuss our approach to education with parents and hope that they will continue to be involved in their children’s education throughout their school career.
We look forward to meeting you. Please phone 0207 727 7727 for an appointment.Best wishes,
Ben McMullen – Headteacher.
